duoVilains.modeDuoMeta: Taking turns, or each on your own phone
duoVilains.relaisDebut: Answer the whole series, then pass the phone.
duoVilains.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
duoVilains.jaugesTitre: What stands out in your answers
duoVilains.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. Each of you answers the fifteen questions separately, and the result gives each one's role in the duo, then the famous duo the two of you form.
duoVilains.setupDesc: Enter your first names. Each of you answers the fifteen questions separately, and the result gives each one's role in the duo, then the famous duo the two of you form.
duoVilains.noteFin: A Halloween quiz, just for fun. The characters belong to their creators; the heist of the century stays imaginary.
duoVilains.p_cerveau_d: You plan everything, you see three moves ahead and you hate improvising.
duoVilains.p_chaos_d: You improvise, you laugh, and you blow up the plan as soon as it bores you.
duoVilains.p_muscle_d: You charge in, you carry, you break things, and you protect the other without saying so.
duoVilains.p_charme_d: You negotiate, you seduce, and you get the keys without forcing the lock.
duoVilains.p_ombre_d: Discreet, loyal, you're there without being seen, and you forget nothing.
duoVilains.p_coeur_d: You follow the other out of love, and you're often the one who makes the crazy move.
duoVilains.d_joker_d: Chaos and heart: one blows up the bank, the other applauds in a matching outfit. You're loud, unpredictable, impossible to separate, even when it would be reasonable. Gotham doesn't sleep anymore.
duoVilains.d_joker_a: For Halloween, get the costume in duplicate. And an emergency exit.
duoVilains.d_bonnie_d: Two lovers against the whole world. You hit the road, you never leave each other, and you don't really have a plan, just each other. It's beautiful, it's romantic, and in the books it ends badly.
duoVilains.d_bonnie_a: For Halloween: a hat, a beret, and an old car if you can find one. Be home before the police.
duoVilains.d_rocket_d: Charm, grand speeches, complicated plans... and failure, every time, with panache. You're funny without meaning to be and you always “blast off again”. Everyone loves you, especially your enemies.
duoVilains.d_rocket_a: At Halloween, prepare a motto to recite together. And don't steal anything, you wouldn't manage.
duoVilains.d_vador_d: The brains and the strong arm. One decides from the shadows, the other executes while breathing heavily. It's efficient, it's chilling, and there's always a moment when one of you gets tired of taking orders.
duoVilains.d_vador_a: For Halloween, the throne and the cape. One of you will have to do the breathing all evening.
duoVilains.d_voldemort_d: The master and the devotee. One wants to control everything, the other follows with a loyalty that scares everyone, him included. Powerful, a little sinister, and nobody dares invite you to dinner.
duoVilains.d_voldemort_a: At Halloween, no mask needed: a laugh and a look will do. Leave the wand at home.
duoVilains.d_ivy_d: The duo that left the bad guys to do better. You're independent, loyal to each other, with a soft spot for plants and bad ideas. The people who know you don't worry anymore, they watch.
duoVilains.d_ivy_a: For Halloween, decorate with ivy and glitter. And keep an eye on the hyena.
duoVilains.d_cortex_d: The brains and the brains, well, almost: one prepares to take over the world every night, the other asks the question that makes it all fall apart. And you start again the next day. That's love.
duoVilains.d_cortex_a: For Halloween, prepare a ten-step plan for trick-or-treating. It'll fail at step two, that's normal.
duoVilains.d_wario_d: Muscle and chaos, comedy version. You're loud, not very elegant, a bit jealous of people who succeed, and endearing in the end. Nobody takes you seriously, and that's your best weapon.
duoVilains.d_wario_a: At Halloween, moustaches are mandatory. For both of you.
duoVilains.d_magneto_d: The shadow and the metal. You're discreet, convinced you're right, and able to change faces when needed. A long-standing duo, with ideas, betrayals and comebacks.
duoVilains.d_magneto_a: For Halloween, a helmet and blue paint. You'll look serious, that's the point.
duoVilains.q1: The heist plan is ready. You...
duoVilains.q1a: I wrote it, minute by minute
duoVilains.q1b: I'm handling the door, whatever it takes
duoVilains.q1c: I convince the guard to look the other way
duoVilains.q1d: I'm not on the plan, and that's on purpose
duoVilains.q2a: I improvise, and honestly it's better this way
duoVilains.q2b: I pull out the plan B I'd prepared
duoVilains.q2c: I protect the other first, we'll see after
duoVilains.q2d: I slip out through the exit I'd spotted
duoVilains.q3: A rival offers you both a place on his crew. You...
duoVilains.q3a: I negotiate shares, for the two of us
duoVilains.q3b: I say no with a single look
duoVilains.q3c: I say yes, then sabotage from the inside
duoVilains.q3d: I set fire to the offer, literally
duoVilains.q4a: An organised bunker, one shelf per type of gadget
duoVilains.q4b: A place that changes every month
duoVilains.q4c: An apartment with a big bed and photos everywhere
duoVilains.q5: Your partner is in danger. You...
duoVilains.q5b: I negotiate their release with a smile
duoVilains.q5c: I organise an operation that will take three days but will work
duoVilains.q5d: I'm already inside, nobody saw me
duoVilains.q6: In the duo, you're the one who...
duoVilains.q6a: Makes people laugh, even at the wrong moment
duoVilains.q6d: Cries at the movies, and takes revenge afterwards
duoVilains.q7: What you're most often blamed for in the duo:
duoVilains.q7d: Disappearing for three days without a word
duoVilains.q9a: I go over the debrief and note the mistakes
duoVilains.q9c: I fall asleep on the other's shoulder
duoVilains.q9d: I stand guard, just in case
duoVilains.q10c: Colours that don't match, on purpose
duoVilains.q10d: Padding: I'm the one who takes the hits
duoVilains.q11a: Proving my plan is the best
duoVilains.q11b: Seeing the look on people's faces
duoVilains.q11c: The other: I'm here for them
duoVilains.q11d: Money, and everything it makes possible
duoVilains.q12a: I confess everything so the other gets away
duoVilains.q12c: I talk a lot, and make it all up
duoVilains.q12d: I'd planned for the arrest: bail is already paid
duoVilains.q13a: Behind the wheel, I drive fast and well
duoVilains.q13b: Next to it, with the map and the plan
duoVilains.q14: Your favourite moment of a plan:
duoVilains.q14a: When everything goes exactly as planned
duoVilains.q14d: When the target hands us the keys with a smile
duoVilains.q15: If the duo ever split up...
duoVilains.q15b: I'd find the other again, out of love or revenge
duoVilains.q15c: I'd put together a new crew in two days
